entries.text: Yan-Yan pushed gently. A fault is a break in rock along which its sides can slip. Here the sides were pressed together, and friction resisted sliding. The loading continued, so the surrounding rock deformed a little elastically. In the enlarged view, straight markings bent.

entries.text: Plates do not wait for an earthquake to move. Processes involving Earth’s internal heat and gravity help drive their slow motion. Moving plates can load rock farther away. A locally locked part of a fault does not mean that a whole plate and all nearby rock have stopped changing.

entries.text: 断层两边的岩石相互接触。被压在一起的接触部位会抵抗滑动，这种阻力与摩擦有关。周围仍受作用时，岩石中的微小弹性形变可以储存能量。它并不需要先出现一条肉眼可见的大弯。

entries.text: Rock on the two sides of a fault is in contact. Contact areas pressed together resist sliding through friction. While the surrounding rock remains loaded, tiny elastic deformation can store energy. No large, visible bend is needed.

entries.text: 在这种锁定后突然滑动的情形中，滑动开始后，阻力可能降低，使滑动很快发展。岩石的弹性形变减小，储存的部分能量释放；滑动停止后，两边仍可有永久错位，也可能仍有未释放的作用。另一些断层可以缓慢滑动，并不是每次板块移动都会发生地震。

entries.text: In this kind of sudden slip after locking, resistance can decrease once sliding starts, allowing slip to develop rapidly. Elastic deformation decreases and some stored energy is released. After motion stops, permanent offset and some remaining loading can persist. Other faults can creep slowly; not every movement of a plate produces an earthquake.

entries.text: As a wave passes, motion and deformation at one place affect neighboring rock, carrying the disturbance onward. One marker moves locally, while energy can travel farther. Real seismic waves have different kinds of motion. This view slows one direction for observation; its circle marks where the disturbance has arrived, not a shell of rock or energy.

entries.text: 接缝还没滑，周围岩石发生了什么？

segments.sourceText: 接缝还没滑，周围岩石发生了什么？
segments.spokenText: 接缝还没滑，周围岩石发生了什么？

entries.text: What changes in the rock while the fault is still stuck?

segments.sourceText: What changes in the rock while the fault is still stuck?
segments.spokenText: What changes in the rock while the fault is still stuck?

entries.text: 从原来的纹路开始看：先让外面的作用继续。

segments.sourceText: 从原来的纹路开始看：先让外面的作用继续。
segments.spokenText: 从原来的纹路开始看：先让外面的作用继续。

entries.text: Start with the original markings. Let loading continue.

segments.sourceText: Start with the original markings. Let loading continue.
segments.spokenText: Start with the original markings. Let loading continue.

entries.text: 接缝锁住，周围岩石形变并储能。灰色虚线留下了原来的纹路。

segments.sourceText: 接缝锁住，周围岩石形变并储能。灰色虚线留下了原来的纹路。
segments.spokenText: 接缝锁住，周围岩石形变并储能。灰色虚线留下了原来的纹路。

entries.text: The fault is locked. Surrounding rock deforms and stores energy. Gray dashed lines show the original markings.

segments.sourceText: The fault is locked. Surrounding rock deforms and stores energy. Gray dashed lines show the original markings.
segments.spokenText: The fault is locked. Surrounding rock deforms and stores energy. Gray dashed lines show the original markings.

entries.text: 阻力被克服，断层开始滑动，周围岩石部分回弹。

segments.sourceText: 阻力被克服，断层开始滑动，周围岩石部分回弹。
segments.spokenText: 阻力被克服，断层开始滑动，周围岩石部分回弹。

entries.text: Resistance is overcome. The fault slips and surrounding rock rebounds partly.

segments.sourceText: Resistance is overcome. The fault slips and surrounding rock rebounds partly.
segments.spokenText: Resistance is overcome. The fault slips and surrounding rock rebounds partly.

entries.text: 变形减小了，纹路却仍错开：回弹与永久错位可以同时留下。

segments.sourceText: 变形减小了，纹路却仍错开：回弹与永久错位可以同时留下。
segments.spokenText: 变形减小了，纹路却仍错开：回弹与永久错位可以同时留下。

entries.text: Deformation decreased, but the markings remain offset: rebound can leave permanent fault offset.

segments.sourceText: Deformation decreased, but the markings remain offset: rebound can leave permanent fault offset.
segments.spokenText: Deformation decreased, but the markings remain offset: rebound can leave permanent fault offset.

entries.text: 看振动传开，也看小标记留在哪里。

segments.sourceText: 看振动传开，也看小标记留在哪里。
segments.spokenText: 看振动传开，也看小标记留在哪里。

entries.text: Watch the disturbance spread, and see where each marker stays.

segments.sourceText: Watch the disturbance spread, and see where each marker stays.
segments.spokenText: Watch the disturbance spread, and see where each marker stays.

entries.text: 地下与地表标记都在原位；同一次振动将依次到达。

segments.sourceText: 地下与地表标记都在原位；同一次振动将依次到达。
segments.spokenText: 地下与地表标记都在原位；同一次振动将依次到达。

entries.text: Both markers are at their starting places. One disturbance will reach them in turn.

segments.sourceText: Both markers are at their starting places. One disturbance will reach them in turn.
segments.spokenText: Both markers are at their starting places. One disturbance will reach them in turn.

entries.text: 振动经过地下标记：标记在附近来回动，变化继续传向地表。

segments.sourceText: 振动经过地下标记：标记在附近来回动，变化继续传向地表。
segments.spokenText: 振动经过地下标记：标记在附近来回动，变化继续传向地表。

entries.text: The disturbance passes the underground marker. It moves locally as the disturbance continues toward the surface.

segments.sourceText: The disturbance passes the underground marker. It moves locally as the disturbance continues toward the surface.
segments.spokenText: The disturbance passes the underground marker. It moves locally as the disturbance continues toward the surface.

entries.text: 振动到达地表，地表标记也来回动起来；地下标记没有跑上来。

segments.sourceText: 振动到达地表，地表标记也来回动起来；地下标记没有跑上来。
segments.spokenText: 振动到达地表，地表标记也来回动起来；地下标记没有跑上来。

entries.text: The disturbance reaches the surface marker and it moves locally too. The underground marker did not travel up here.

segments.sourceText: The disturbance reaches the surface marker and it moves locally too. The underground marker did not travel up here.
segments.spokenText: The disturbance reaches the surface marker and it moves locally too. The underground marker did not travel up here.

entries.text: 脉冲已经过这两个标记，它们回到原位附近；到达记录留下了传播的先后。

segments.sourceText: 脉冲已经过这两个标记，它们回到原位附近；到达记录留下了传播的先后。
segments.spokenText: 脉冲已经过这两个标记，它们回到原位附近；到达记录留下了传播的先后。

entries.text: The pulse has passed both markers. They are near their starting places; arrival records show the sequence of propagation.

segments.sourceText: The pulse has passed both markers. They are near their starting places; arrival records show the sequence of propagation.
segments.spokenText: The pulse has passed both markers. They are near their starting places; arrival records show the sequence of propagation.

entries.text: 灰色圈是原位，彩色点是现在：放大看往返，不随波跑走。

segments.sourceText: 灰色圈是原位，彩色点是现在：放大看往返，不随波跑走。
segments.spokenText: 灰色圈是原位，彩色点是现在：放大看往返，不随波跑走。

entries.text: The gray ring is the starting place; the colored point is its current position. Enlarge the back-and-forth motion without following the wave.

segments.sourceText: The gray ring is the starting place; the colored point is its current position. Enlarge the back-and-forth motion without following the wave.
segments.spokenText: The gray ring is the starting place; the colored point is its current position. Enlarge the back-and-forth motion without following the wave.

entries.text: 持续作用 → 形变储能 → 断层滑动与部分回弹 → 地震波传播 → 地面振动。

segments.sourceText: 持续作用 → 形变储能 → 断层滑动与部分回弹 → 地震波传播 → 地面振动。
segments.spokenText: 持续作用 → 形变储能 → 断层滑动与部分回弹 → 地震波传播 → 地面振动。

entries.text: Continued loading → elastic deformation and stored energy → fault slip and partial rebound → seismic waves → ground motion.

segments.sourceText: Continued loading → elastic deformation and stored energy → fault slip and partial rebound → seismic waves → ground motion.
segments.spokenText: Continued loading → elastic deformation and stored energy → fault slip and partial rebound → seismic waves → ground motion.
